start.text: The canes knit shut behind you with a sound like a long breath let out. The camp goes with it: no saw, no stove, no sea.
The cart road runs on ahead, straight north, ruts and all, into fog the colour of old ash. The pines along it have gone grey to the needle.
Beside you stands the first waymark. From the camp its hook was empty. From here a lantern hangs on it, and the fog stands off from its light the way it stands off from your hand.
Off to the west, away from the road and between the trees, a second lantern glimmers.
